data.description:
## Description

**What**: Write failing tests for plugins/dso/scripts/scan-todo-comments.sh that scans plugins/dso/ for TODO/FIXME/HACK/WORKAROUND comments and emits JSON classifying each by disposition (auto-remove, ticket-candidate, quick-fix-candidate, already-ticketed).

**Why**: SC-1 requires every such comment to be evaluated; a deterministic scanner enables reproducible sweeps and prevents missing comments.

**Scope**: Create tests/test-scan-todo-comments.sh with fixture files covering: (a) bare TODO with no ticket ref, (b) TODO referencing existing ticket ID, (c) FIXME with inline fix hint, (d) HACK with multi-line explanation, (e) WORKAROUND referencing closed ticket, (f) comment inside string literal (ignored), (g) commented-out TODO inside markdown code fence (ignored for code files).

## Acceptance Criteria

- tests/test-scan-todo-comments.sh exists, is executable (chmod +x), runs via test-batched.sh --runner=bash
- Test fixtures cover all 7 cases
- Each test asserts JSON schema fields: path, line, kind, text, ticket_ref, disposition_hint
- Tests FAIL because plugins/dso/scripts/scan-todo-comments.sh does not exist (RED state confirmed)
- No production script created in this task
data.title: RED: Scanner script classifies TODO/FIXME/HACK/WORKAROUND comments by disposition
